[[Aspertia City]] }} '''New Sword Player''' (Japanese: '''VSトルネロスれいじゅうフォルムII''' ''VS {{tt|Tornelos Sacred Beast Forme|Tornadus Therian Forme}} II''), titled '''VS Tornadus Therian Forme II''' in the [[Shogakukan Asia]] translation, is the 533rd chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the ninth chapter of the {{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}. It is subtitled '''Tornadus: Therian Forme II''' (Japanese: '''ニュー・ソードプレイヤー''' ''New Sword Player'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''New Sword Player''' in the Shogakukan Asia translation. ==Plot== {{incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * {{adv|Blake}} battles against {{DL|Forces of nature (Adventures)|Tornadus}} with {{TP|Blake|Dewott}} and [[Kelden]]. * Tornadus reveals that its true target is [[Giallo]], who refuses to accept [[Colress]] as [[Team Plasma]]'s new leader. * Dewott and Kelden freeze {{p|Tornadus}}, forcing the {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s to recall it and retreat. * {{adv|Looker}} arrests Giallo. * {{adv|Whitley}} is revealed to have fallen asleep, preventing her from being able to recognize Giallo. * Blake takes Whitley to a concert performed by [[Roxie]] and her band. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== * [[Roxie]] ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Krookodile}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Blake}} * {{adv|Whitley}} * {{adv|Looker}} * {{adv|N}} (silhouette; fantasy) * [[Roxie]] * [[Colress]] (fantasy) * [[Giallo]] * [[Hugh's sister]] * [[Billy Jo]] * {{un|Nicky}} * {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Dewott}} ({{OP|Blake|Dewott}}) * {{p|Keldeo}} ([[Kelden]]; {{adv|Blake}}'s) * {{p|Foongus}} ([[Foongy]]; {{adv|Whitley}}'s) * {{p|Croagunk}} ({{OP|Looker|Croagunk}}) * {{p|Krookodile}} ([[Giallo]]'s) * {{p|Tornadus}} ({{DL|Forces of nature (Adventures)|Tornadus|Team Plasma's}}; Therian Forme) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== * Kelden uses {{m|Ice Beam}} in the online version of this chapter.
